title: Maximum Difference Between Increasing Elements
goal: Find the largest positive difference with the smaller value at an earlier index.
strategy: Retain the smallest value seen before the current position. A current value larger than that minimum is a valid endpoint; equal values do not form a positive difference.

phasePurposes.start: Find the largest positive difference with the smaller value at an earlier index.
phasePurposes.inspect: Retain the smallest value seen before the current position. A current value larger than that minimum is a valid endpoint; equal values do not form a positive difference.

phasePurposes.done: Find the largest positive difference with the smaller value at an earlier index.

edgeCases: Strict decrease has no valid pair
Equal values are not a strict increase
Two entries form the only candidate
